reuse.why: Expresses the rule through the existing recurConfigToRSchedule and the recurrence library's day-of-week filter, so every existing consumer picks it up without new code.

duplication.why: A single four-line change in one function; nothing is repeated.

placement.why: The daily-schedule rule sits in the `case 'daily'` branch of recurConfigToRSchedule in shared/schedules.ts, the function that already turns a recur config into recurrence rules.

scope.why: Only the rule, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Minimal, declarative and located where all schedule-occurrence builders (rule-utils, find-schedules, getUpcomingDates) already converge.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All RSchedule construction in server/ and shared/ goes through recurConfigToRSchedule, which now carries the rule.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts recurConfigToRSchedule 'daily' case, used by parseRecurDate (getNextDate/getNextDateAfter), find-schedules and getUpcomingDates.
